observations.behavior: Documentation update: the exclusion list for the FDA API inventory was modified. The entry 'tobacco/*' was replaced with 'research/* (tobacco ad studies and the static covidmirnaandproteomics study dataset)', while the original 'tobacco/*' exclusion was removed. This changes the documented set of excluded endpoints.
observations.code_quote: Note: Endpoint inventory taken from api.fda.gov/download.json, which enumerates every openFDA category and endpoint. Excluded from the list: tobacco/\*, research/\* (tobacco ad studies and the static covidmirnaandproteomics study dataset), transparency/crl, other/historicaldocument, other/substance and device/covid19serology as niche or archival.
